hooks.command: f=".zcode/hooks/session-start.py"; d="${ZCODE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; if [ -z "$d" ] || [ ! -f "$d/$f" ]; then d="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; fi; if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/$f" ]; then ZCODE_PROJECT_DIR="$d" exec python3 "$d/$f"; fi; exit 0
